_readme: Generator manifest for the in-game /cegen command (patcherMod devtools/GeneratorRunner) and the
optional run at game startup (config/creativeengineering-common.toml [debug.generators]).
Entries run one at a time, in this order, so put a generator after anything it reads:
gen_structure_config writes structure_config.json, which build_biome_merges, the analyzer and gen_structure_groups read;
gen_structure_groups also reads biome_merges.json and biome_config.json, so it runs after both.
A failed entry is reported and the rest still run.
Fields per generator:
id        name used by /cegen run <id>
script    path from the instance root, run with the configured python from the instance root
args      extra command-line arguments (optional)
groups    /cegen run <group> runs every entry in the group; 'all' runs everything
dumps     in-game commands whose kubejs/exported/ output the script reads. /cegen run <target> dumps
runs them first; plain runs (and the startup run) use whatever the last dump left
outputs   files or folders the script writes. Hashed before and after, so chat can say what changed
apply     what makes a changed output take effect, shown only when something changed
warnExit  exit codes that mean 'finished with findings' rather than 'failed' (optional)
highlight extra regexes, on top of the top-level list, whose matching output lines go to chat
Not listed on purpose: dump_server_mods.py (it copies ~300 jars; in game it is /dumpservermods), echo_texture.py and
potion_bucket_texture.py (one-off art tools that take arguments), gen_bedspreads/elytra_pattern_compat.py
(they write patcherMod resources, so their output needs a jar rebuild, not a game restart).
